primitives.name: ExactRationalBlockMap
primitives.statement: Two-site arithmetic averaging is performed on exact rational field values.
primitives.operational_definition: Use Fraction-valued states and pairwise averaging.

primitives.name: FineEightSiteBoltzmannMeasure
primitives.statement: The microscopic witness is the periodic N=8 scalar lattice over {-1,0,1}^8 with kappa=m2=lambda=1.
primitives.operational_definition: Enumerate all 6561 microscopic states and weight by exp(-S).

primitives.name: ScaleWiseProjectionCourt
primitives.statement: Each exact coarse effective action is projected onto a retained operator basis and candidate extensions are scored by action RSS and distribution KL.
primitives.operational_definition: Use uniform-support least squares plus KL(P_exact||P_candidate).

definitions.name: ScaleEffectiveAction
definitions.statement: S_eff^(k)(y)=-log W_k(y) on each coarse support.

definitions.name: FlowGenome
definitions.statement: Each scale records site count, support, partition, retained basis, coefficients, residuals, KL, candidate court, and identifiability.

claims.statement: Repeated pair averaging equals direct group averaging exactly on all 6561 microscopic states for one, two, and three block steps.
The finite push-forward flow preserves total partition weight and repeated push-forward agrees numerically with direct push-forward within declared tolerance.
Every coarse level inherits global Z2 symmetry and its exact support-level effective action reconstructs pushed weights within declared tolerance.
The restricted retained base operator family is not exactly closed under the tested finite block flow.
Candidate operator identifiability can depend on scale and finite support; M6 is redundant/singular at 4 sites but identifiable at coarser tested levels.
The best tested operator can depend on both scale and score functional.
A useful finite RG discovery engine can track scale-wise operator generation, identifiability, Pareto scores, and R11-compatible residual budgets before extrapolation to larger systems.

observables.name: SupportCount
observables.definition: Number of exact coarse states with nonzero pushed weight.

observables.name: ActionResidualRMS
observables.definition: Uniform-support RMS discrepancy between exact and projected effective action.

observables.name: DistributionKL
observables.definition: KL divergence from exact coarse probability to candidate Boltzmann distribution.

metadata.purpose: Construct and verify an exact finite multiscale block flow with scale-wise effective-action projection.
